name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: Ancient rock citadel dating back to the 5th century AD, featuring world-renowned frescoes, mirror wall, and water gardens.
activities: History, Sightseeing, Photography, Architecture, Rock Climbing

name: Ella & Nine Arch Bridge
description: Idyllic mountain hamlet surrounded by misty cloud forests, tea estates, the iconic colonial viaduct bridge, and dramatic viewpoints.
activities: Hiking, Photography, Train Watching, Sightseeing, Cafe Culture, Waterfalls

name: Galle Dutch Fort
description: UNESCO World Heritage 17th-century fortified city built by the Portuguese and Dutch, packed with colonial boutique villas, ramparts, and lighthouse.
activities: History, Shopping, Dining, Photography, Ocean Walks, Architecture

name: Yala National Park
description: Sri Lanka's premier wildlife sanctuary boasting the world's highest density of leopards, sloth bears, wild elephants, and coastal lagoons.
activities: Wildlife Safari, Photography, Bird Watching, Nature Trails

name: Mirissa Beach & Whale Watching
description: Crescent golden beach famed for Blue Whale expeditions, vibrant beach clubs, Coconut Tree Hill, and beginner surfing.
activities: Whale Watching, Beach Relaxation, Surfing, Snorkeling, Nightlife, Sunset Views

name: Nuwara Eliya (Little England)
description: Highland capital blanketed in verdant Ceylon tea bushes, temperate climate, English Tudor architecture, Lake Gregory, and strawberry farms.
activities: Tea Factory Tours, Boating, Horse Riding, Golfing, Sightseeing, Gardens

name: Kandy Temple of the Tooth
description: Sacred Buddhist shrine housing the relic of the tooth of the Buddha, located in the royal palace complex beside scenic Kandy Lake.
activities: Spiritual, History, Cultural Dances, Museums, Lake Walks

name: Kitulgala Adventure Rainforest
description: The adventure heart of Sri Lanka along the Kelani River, famous for exhilarating grade 3-4 white water rafting, canyoning, and rainforest trekking.
activities: White Water Rafting, Canyoning, Waterfall Abseiling, Jungle Trekking, Kayaking

name: Knuckles Mountain Range
description: UNESCO biosphere reserve with rugged peaks resembling a clenched fist, offering pristine cloud forests, hidden waterfalls, and remote villages.
activities: Multi-day Trekking, Camping, Wildlife, Bird Watching, Nature Photography

name: Arugam Bay Surf Haven
description: Renowned right-hand point break surf destination on Sri Lanka's sunny eastern coastline, with laidback bohemian cafes and lagoon safaris.
activities: Surfing, Lagoon Safari, Beach Parties, Yoga, Seafood Dining

name: Horton Plains & World's End
description: High-altitude plateau featuring montane grassland, the dramatic 880m sheer drop cliff known as World's End, and Baker's Falls.
activities: Hiking, Wildlife Spotting, Photography, Baker's Falls, Scenic Views

name: Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
description: Conical 2,243m sacred mountain pilgrimage site revered by multiple world religions, renowned for its spiritual nighttime staircase trek and sunrise shadow.
activities: Pilgrimage, Night Trekking, Sunrise Viewing, Spiritual, Photography

name: Trincomalee & Nilaveli Beach
description: Pristine white sand beaches on the East Coast, snorkeling coral reefs at Pigeon Island Marine Sanctuary, and historic Koneswaram temple on Swami Rock.
activities: Snorkeling, Scuba Diving, Beach Lounging, Temple Visits, Whale Watching

name: Minneriya National Park
description: Site of 'The Gathering', the largest seasonal congregation of wild Asian elephants in the world during the dry season around the ancient reservoir.
activities: Elephant Gathering Safari, Bird Watching, Nature Photography

name: Anuradhapura Sacred Ancient City
description: The first ancient capital of Sri Lanka, home to colossal brick stupas like Ruwanwelisaya and the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi, the oldest historically documented tree.
activities: Ancient Ruins, Cycling, Spiritual Pilgrimage, Archaeology, Photography

name: Dambulla Golden Cave Temple
description: The largest and best-preserved cave temple complex in Sri Lanka, boasting 5 sanctuary caves adorned with 153 Buddha statues and vivid religious murals.
activities: History, Buddhist Art, Cave Exploring, Scenic Panoramic Views

name: Bentota River & Golden Beach
description: Premier water sports and luxury resort coastline where the tranquil river meets the Indian ocean; renowned for jet skiing, banana boating, and turtle hatcheries.
activities: Jet Skiing, Windsurfing, Mangrove Boat Safari, Turtle Hatchery, Ayurveda

name: Sinharaja Rain Forest Reserve
description: UNESCO World Heritage primary tropical rainforest, an extraordinary hotspot for endemic birds, mammals, rare flora, and untouched wilderness trails.
activities: Jungle Trekking, Endemic Bird Watching, Botany, Waterfall Swimming

name: Polonnaruwa Medieval Kingdom
description: Splendid second ancient capital showcasing well-preserved royal palaces, lotus baths, and the masterwork rock-cut Gal Vihara Buddha statues.
activities: Bicycle Touring, Ancient Architecture, Photography, Historical Studies

name: Pidurangala Rock
description: An adventurous scramble uphill yielding the most iconic 360-degree panoramic sunrise viewpoint directly facing the magnificent Sigiriya Rock.
activities: Sunrise Hiking, Bouldering, Photography, Reclining Buddha Visit

name: Weligama Bay Surf Colony
description: Sheltered gentle sandy bay internationally famed as the ideal hotspot for beginner and intermediate surfers with dozens of surf schools.
activities: Surf Lessons, Taprobane Island View, Seafood Grills, Paddleboarding

name: Colombo City & Galle Face Green
description: Dynamic commercial capital blending colonial Dutch hospital precinct, modern Lotus Tower skyline, lively street food at Galle Face, and Gangaramaya temple.
activities: City Walk, Street Food, Lotus Tower Observation, Shopping, Nightlife, Museums

name: Wilpattu National Park
description: Sri Lanka's largest and oldest national park characterised by natural sand-rimmed water basins ('Villus'), dense dry forest, and elusive leopards.
activities: Off-road Safari, Leopard Tracking, Birding, Wilderness Camping

name: Jaffna Peninsula & Nallur Temple
description: The cultural epicenter of Sri Lankan Tamil culture, boasting vibrant Dravidian kovils, Dutch Fort, authentic spicy Jaffna crab curry, and tranquil islands.
activities: Temple Ceremonies, Culinary Tasting, Historical Forts, Island Ferries

name: Diyaluma Falls & Natural Infinity Pools
description: Sri Lanka's second highest waterfall with sensational multi-tiered natural rock pools perched precariously on the cliff edge for breathtaking swimming.
activities: Cliff Pool Swimming, Hike to Top, Photography, Picnic

name: Udawalawe Elephant Sanctuary
description: Sri Lanka's answer to the African savannah, guaranteeing wild elephant sightings in open grasslands alongside the Elephant Transit Home nursery.
activities: Elephant Safari, Transit Home Feeding, Bird Watching

name: Tangalle & Goyambokka Beach
description: Secluded tropical bays framed by swaying palms and azure waves; tranquil luxury escapes with nesting sea turtles at Rekawa beach.
activities: Turtle Night Watching, Swimming, Cliff Dining, Relaxation

name: Haputale & Lipton's Seat
description: The exact summit where Sir Thomas Lipton once stood proudly surveying his tea empire, overlooking a panorama that sweeps all the way to the southern ocean.
activities: Sunrise Viewing, Tea Plantation Walks, Dambatenne Factory Tour, Tuk-tuk Ride

name: Kalpitiya Kite Surfing & Dolphins
description: World-class kite surfing lagoon with constant trade winds, and offshore waters where pods of hundreds of spinner dolphins leap alongside boats.
activities: Kite Surfing, Dolphin Watching, Sandbar Camping, Seafood Dinners
best_season: May to October & December to March

name: Ravana Falls & Cave
description: Dramatic 25m cascading waterfall linked to the Indian epic Ramayana legend, where King Ravana is said to have hidden Princess Sita.
activities: Waterfall Sightseeing, Cave Exploration, Photography, Local Snacks
